report_metadata.sdlc_rationale: Requirements fully defined and signed off with fixed deadline and budget, but new hire satisfaction and HR efficiency gains require working software validation; scope is clear enough for predictive phase structure with adaptive sprint cycles in Phase 2–3.

project_understanding.primary_goal: Build a self-service employee onboarding portal enabling new hires to complete required paperwork, set up IT accounts, and get team introductions before day one.
project_understanding.beneficiary: New employees (100–200/year) and HR team (5 people)
project_understanding.trigger: Current onboarding is fragmented across PDF-based paperwork, manual IT account setup, and no pre-day-one preparation; CEO requested HR fix after hearing complaints at all-hands.
success_definition: 80% of onboarding tasks completed by new hires before day one
IT account setup fully automated (zero manual tickets)
supporting_quotes: Create a self-service employee onboarding portal that allows new hires to complete all required paperwork, set up their IT accounts, and get introduced to the team before day one.
Currently onboarding is fragmented - paperwork is PDF-based, IT account setup is manual, new hires feel unprepared on day one.

New hires can complete 80% of onboarding tasks before day one; HR time spent on onboarding admin reduced by 50%; IT account setup automated (no manual tickets); New hire satisfaction survey score > 4/5

assumption_log.what: Workday API sandbox environment, documentation, and SLA are available and stable for integration development and testing.
assumption_log.why: External API availability is a hard dependency for UC7 (Retrieve Employee Data) and cannot be assumed without explicit confirmation; integration delays directly impact Phase 2 delivery.
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 6th Ed, Section 8.1 (Resource Planning) and Section 12.2 (Manage Communications)
assumption_log.consequence: Phase 2 integration work blocked; onboarding form pre-population cannot be tested; go-live delayed by 2–4 weeks minimum.
assumption_log.tradeoff: Gains: Confirms integration feasibility and timeline realism. Risks: If API unavailable or undocumented, team must build manual data entry fallback or delay launch.

assumption_log.what: Azure AD tenant is already provisioned, team has existing SSO integration experience, and Azure AD API/Graph permissions are pre-approved for account provisioning (UC4).
assumption_log.why: UC4 (Provision IT Accounts) and UC6 (Authenticate via SSO) depend on Azure AD; if team lacks experience or permissions are not pre-approved, architecture and timeline shift significantly.
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 6th Ed, Section 9.1 (Resource Management Plan) and Section 13.1 (Stakeholder Engagement)
assumption_log.consequence: Security review delays; account provisioning automation scope reduced to manual approval workflow; Phase 2 timeline extends 2–3 weeks; IT Director sign-off delayed.
assumption_log.tradeoff: Gains: Confirms team capability and infrastructure readiness. Risks: If permissions denied or team inexperienced, must add security review cycle and reduce automation scope.

assumption_log.what: E-signature service (UC2) is already contracted, API is documented, and legal/compliance has pre-approved the vendor for SOC 2 compliance.
assumption_log.why: Document e-signature is a must-have feature and compliance-critical; vendor lock-in and compliance sign-off are prerequisites that cannot be assumed.
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 6th Ed, Section 5.2 (Collect Requirements) and Section 10.1 (Plan Communications)
assumption_log.consequence: Vendor selection and legal review add 2–3 weeks; if vendor does not meet SOC 2 requirements, alternative must be sourced; Phase 2 document collection feature delayed.
assumption_log.tradeoff: Gains: Confirms compliance path and vendor readiness. Risks: If vendor unavailable or non-compliant, must re-select and re-negotiate; launch delayed.

assumption_log.what: Data retention policy for onboarding documents (I-9, W-4, direct deposit, audit logs) is defined by Legal/Compliance and aligns with SOC 2 requirements.
assumption_log.why: SOC 2 compliance (stated hard constraint) requires explicit data retention and deletion policies; absence of this policy creates compliance risk and affects database schema design.
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 6th Ed, Section 5.2 (Collect Requirements) and Section 10.1 (Plan Communications)
assumption_log.consequence: Database schema must be redesigned post-build to support retention policies; audit log retention unclear; SOC 2 assessment fails; re-architecture required.
assumption_log.tradeoff: Gains: Confirms compliance scope and storage architecture. Risks: If policy undefined, team builds without retention logic; compliance review fails; rework required.

hard.technology_stack: Frontend: React + TypeScript; Backend: Node.js + PostgreSQL; Integration: Workday API, Azure AD; Hosting: Azure App Service
hard.compliance: SOC 2 compliance required (data handling, audit logs)

nfr.security: Azure AD SSO authentication; SOC 2 compliance; audit logging for all document submissions and account provisioning actions

open_questions_pre_planning.question: Is the Workday API sandbox environment available, documented, and stable for integration development? What is the SLA for API availability during Phase 2 testing?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: Integration work blocked; form pre-population cannot be tested; Phase 2 timeline at risk.

open_questions_pre_planning.question: Does the team have prior experience with Azure AD account provisioning and Graph API? Are Graph API permissions pre-approved by Security for automated account creation?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: IT account provisioning automation scope may be reduced; Phase 2 timeline extends 2–3 weeks; IT Director sign-off delayed.

open_questions_pre_planning.question: Which e-signature service vendor is contracted, and has Legal/Compliance confirmed SOC 2 compliance for that vendor?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: Vendor selection and legal review add 2–3 weeks; if vendor non-compliant, alternative must be sourced; Phase 2 document collection delayed.

open_questions_pre_planning.question: What is the data retention policy for onboarding documents (I-9, W-4, direct deposit) and audit logs? Who owns this policy (Legal, Compliance, HR)?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: Database schema must be redesigned post-build; SOC 2 assessment fails; re-architecture required.

open_questions_pre_planning.question: Who is the Product Owner responsible for backlog prioritization and sprint-level scope decisions during Phase 2–3?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: Hybrid SDLC sprint cycles cannot proceed; decision-making delays; scope creep unmanaged.
